title: How a Unicorn Called Buddy Became a Surprise Movie Hit
summary:
In 2026, a movie called Buddy became a surprise hit. It is a horror comedy by Casper Kelly about a 1990s TV show mascot with a dark side. According to the people who made it, what made Buddy stand out was not just the jokes or the scares. It was the feeling underneath.

Buddy the Unicorn is funny and charming, but he also has a darker side and feels sorry for what he does. That mix helped build a very unusual marketing campaign. Roadside Attractions showed people the character first, before revealing his darker side. The campaign made many people wonder if Buddy was a cancelled TV show they had forgotten about. By then, they already cared about the character.

At a filmmaking summit in Los Angeles, producer Tracy Rosenblum, co-writer Jamie King, and marketing head Melissa Yerou talked about the years of work behind the overnight success. King said he knew Kelly would make it really funny, and his friends at BoulderLight would make it really scary, so he tried to add heart.
why_it_matters: It can help you notice how a character or story can win your interest before you know the whole story.
